title: Adopt writes a host registry of adopted repositories and harvest --from-ledger proposes records from rework and red-CI PRs
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 9: .krn/adopted.json absent; harvest ran once by hand.
Outcome: adopt registers the repo in a host registry; krn standards harvest --from-ledger turns each rework or CI-failed merged PR into a proposal with #PR evidence across registered repos.
Proof: harvest with no arguments lists candidates from the registry (fixture repos).
